backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (about 262K tokens per step). With a fixed 300 s budget on an A100, more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE at 64 so grad accumulation drops to 4 micro-steps.
backlog.title: Lower total batch to 2**18

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 64, which gives 2 micro-steps per step. This tests the extreme small-batch, many-steps regime. If the loop asserts divisibility, adjust it. Optionally scale MATRIX_LR by 0.85.
backlog.title: Lower total batch to 2**17

backlog.spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.65 so the LR decays linearly over a longer final portion of the time budget.
backlog.title: Warmdown ratio 0.65

backlog.spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.35 to leave more time at peak LR.
backlog.title: Warmdown ratio 0.35

backlog.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR does not decay fully to zero.
backlog.title: Final LR fraction 0.05

backlog.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to stabilize the first steps of Muon and Adam at high LRs.
backlog.title: Short warmup

backlog.spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05. Muon often tolerates higher LRs in short runs.
backlog.title: Matrix LR 0.05

backlog.spec: Lower MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 to check whether the current value is too high.
backlog.title: Matrix LR 0.03

backlog.spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4. This tests the Adam LR for token embeddings.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.4

backlog.spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008.
backlog.title: Unembedding LR 0.008

backlog.spec: Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 for the per-layer scalar parameters.
backlog.title: Scalar LR 0.25

backlog.spec: Lower the Muon cautious WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1. The short run may need less regularization.
backlog.title: Weight decay 0.1

backlog.spec: Make the Muon weight decay follow the LR multiplier. Scale it linearly as WEIGHT_DECAY * (1 - progress), so it goes to zero at the end of training. Implement this where the optimizer groups are updated each step.
backlog.title: Weight decay decaying schedule

backlog.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates on the embeddings and scalars.
backlog.title: Adam beta2 0.99

backlog.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.95).
backlog.title: Adam beta1 0.9

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim = 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64). A smaller model gets more tokens in 300 s. Check that the dim is a multiple of HEAD_DIM. If it isn't, set ASPECT_RATIO = 86 so the dim becomes 516, then round to 512.
backlog.title: Depth 6, wider-per-compute

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 and keep ASPECT_RATIO at 64, so the dim is 640. Use DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 32 if it OOMs. This tests whether a bigger model wins despite seeing fewer tokens.
backlog.title: Depth 10

backlog.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 to double the number of attention heads. This may improve quality at similar cost on the A100 with flash attention.
backlog.title: Head dim 64

backlog.spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSL" or "SSSSL". Try "SSSSL" first. Fewer full-attention layers give faster steps, and the final layer is still forced to be L.
backlog.title: Window pattern SSSSL

backlog.spec: Keep the pattern but shrink the short window from half context to a quarter of the sequence length. Find where the window sizes are computed (sequence_len // 2) and change the short window to sequence_len // 4. This is faster, and the L layers still carry long-range information.
backlog.title: All-short windows with a quarter context

backlog.spec: Lower the logit softcap value, if the model uses one (probably 15 or 30), to 12. If there is none, add logits = 15 * tanh(logits / 15) before the loss in float32.
backlog.title: Softcap logits 15

backlog.spec: If the MLP uses relu squared, keep it but test a hidden size of 3x instead of 4x with a gated variant: out = proj(relu(gate(x))**2 * up(x)), with hidden = 2.67*dim rounded to a multiple of 64. It should have about the same parameter count.
backlog.title: ReLU^2 MLP to SwiGLU-lite

backlog.spec: Zero-initialize the attention c_proj and MLP c_proj weights, if they aren't already. This gives a clean residual start and often helps early training in short runs.
backlog.title: Zero-init output projections check

backlog.spec: Make sure the Adam param groups use fused=True. Also ensure bf16 autocast and TF32 matmul (torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('high')) are enabled. This raises throughput, so more steps fit in 300 s.
backlog.title: Torch compile max-autotune off, fused AdamW

backlog.spec: Remove any periodic logging that calls .item() or cuda synchronize on every step. Sync only every 50 steps. This removes host stalls and gives more steps in the fixed time budget. Keep the time accounting intact.
backlog.title: Disable gradient-free overhead: eval-less loop

backlog.spec: If value embeddings are used on alternating layers, restrict them to the last 3 layers only. This saves parameters and compute, with a small quality tradeoff to test.
backlog.title: Value embedding on fewer layers

backlog.spec: Initialize the token embedding with std 0.5 instead of 1.0 (or 1.0 instead of the current value, if it is already 0.5). Initialize lm_head with std 0.001. This tests the init scale.
backlog.title: Embedding dropout-free untied init scale

backlog.spec: Shorten the Muon momentum ramp from 0.85 to 0.95. Make it reach 0.95 within the first 100 steps instead of 300. Or, if the ramp is time-based, make it reach 0.95 at 10% of the budget.
backlog.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter

backlog.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before the optimizer step. This stabilizes the Adam-trained embeddings at the high LR of 0.6.
backlog.title: Gradient clipping 1.0

backlog.spec: Reduce the Muon Newton-Schulz iterations from 5 to 4, if the coefficients allow. This trims optimizer overhead slightly. Otherwise keep the polar-express coefficients and only truncate the list to 4.
backlog.title: Muon Newton-Schulz steps 4

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 5 and ASPECT_RATIO = 77 so model_dim is about 385; if required, round so model_dim is a multiple of HEAD_DIM (128), e.g. ASPECT_RATIO = 76.8 -> use dim 384. Keep all else unchanged. Tests whether fewer, wider layers give more steps in the fixed 300 s and better bpb. Make sure the window pattern string still works for 5 layers (last layer is always full).
backlog.title: Depth 5 with wider model

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 so each optimizer step uses 4 micro-batches of 64x2048 instead of 8 (grad accumulation halves). With only 300 s of training the smaller model benefits from more optimizer steps. Leave LRs unchanged. If Muon momentum warmup is step-based it will scale naturally.
backlog.title: Total batch 2**18 with device batch 64

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 (2 micro-batches per step at device batch 64) and MATRIX_LR = 0.03 to compensate for noisier gradients. A bolder small-batch, many-steps regime for the 300 s budget.
backlog.title: Total batch 2**17 with matrix LR 0.03

backlog.spec: Change the logit softcap constant (currently probably 15 or 30 in forward, e.g. 15 * tanh(logits/15)) to 10 if 15, or to 15 if 30. Single constant change in GPT.forward. Checks whether tighter softcapping helps stability at this tiny scale.
backlog.title: Untied logit softcap 15 and lower

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.6 and FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.1 so the LR decays more gradually and does not reach zero. Keep all else unchanged.
backlog.title: Final LR fraction 0.1 with warmdown 0.6

backlog.spec: Reduce Muon's Newton-Schulz orthogonalization iterations from 5 to 4 (the ns_steps constant in the Muon step function). Saves a little optimizer compute per step to get more steps in 300 s; check loss does not degrade.
backlog.title: Muon Newton-Schulz with 4 steps

backlog.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.4 and UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008 together. The smaller model may prefer a gentler embedding rate and a faster lm_head rate. Only change these two constants.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.4 and unembedding LR 0.008

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "L" so every layer uses full-context attention. With a shrunken 6-layer model the sliding window may hurt more than it saves; flash attention full causal is fast enough on A100. Only change the constant.
backlog.title: All-long windows (WINDOW_PATTERN L)

backlog.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.99) and add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) right before the optimizer step, after the last micro-batch backward. Combines two earlier small gains with smoother Adam statistics for embeddings and scalars.
backlog.title: Ramp sequence-free: Adam beta1 0.9 and beta2 0.99 with clipping 1.0

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64, so 2 micro-batches per step). Halving the batch again doubles optimizer steps within the 300 s budget; the last batch halving gave -0.0166. If Muon/Adam behave poorly, leave other hyperparameters unchanged for a clean comparison.
backlog.title: Total batch 2**17

backlog.spec: In the model forward, change the logit softcap (currently likely 30 via 30*tanh(logits/30)) to 15. Apply the same softcap in the training path only if the existing code already does so; do not touch the evaluation call. Tests whether tighter logit bounding stabilizes the small fast-stepping model.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the warmdown ends at 5% of peak LR instead of zero. Change nothing else.
backlog.title: Final LR fraction 0.05

backlog.spec: Make Muon cautious weight decay follow the schedule: wd = WEIGHT_DECAY * (1 - progress) where progress is training_time/budget, updated each step alongside the LR and momentum schedules. Keep WEIGHT_DECAY 0.2 initially. Strong decay early, none at the end.
backlog.title: Weight decay linearly decayed to zero

backlog.spec: Set UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008 for the lm_head Adam group. With the smaller batch and shallower model the head may be under-trained.
backlog.title: Unembedding LR 0.008

backlog.spec: If the model uses value embeddings (ResFormer-style) on every layer or on alternating layers, restrict them to only the last 2 layers (or otherwise fewer than now). This removes big embedding tables, reducing parameters and memory and speeding steps; check that the optimizer param groups still cover all remaining parameters.
backlog.title: Value embeddings on alternating layers only

backlog.spec: Replace the ReLU^2 MLP with a gated MLP: out = c_proj(silu(c_fc_gate(x)) * c_fc_up(x)), with hidden dim = round(8/3 * n_embd) to a multiple of 64 so parameter count stays about equal. Keep c_proj zero-initialized and all matrices in the Muon group.
backlog.title: SwiGLU-style gated MLP with matched params

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 and MATRIX_LR = 0.06 together. Also set the Muon momentum ramp end at 0.95. Tests a more aggressive, higher-step-count regime in one go.
backlog.title: Bold: Muon matrix LR 0.06 with batch 2**17

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 4 and ASPECT_RATIO = 128 so model_dim = 512 (4 heads of 128). Fewer, wider layers are faster per step in wall-clock on an A100, so more tokens are seen in 300 s. Keep other settings unchanged, and use WINDOW_PATTERN 'L' if the pattern length causes issues.
backlog.title: Bold: Depth 4 wide model

incumbent.description: Reduce total batch size to 2**18 to increase optimizer step count while keeping per-step details large enough to fit in 300s on the DEPTH=6 model, trading throughput for more gradient updates.
